title: Canonical module/set equivalence of strict-local terminal sections
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, f:X→Y any morphism of schemes, s:Spec Ω→Y a geometric point and F a sheaf of Λ-modules on X [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Put ρ:S→Y for the strict-henselization structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map], A=X×_Y S and B=S×_Y X [def-pc-fibre-product], with g:A→X, h:B→X and pullback symmetry σ:A≅B. Define an equivalence from the underlying set of Γ(A,g*F) to the sections at the terminal etale object of h⁻¹(UF), where U forgets coefficients. It is the composite: global sections to terminal module sections; inverse of the canonical module/set inverse-image comparison; inverse of the inverse-image composition comparison for σ and h (using σ≫h=g); the restriction comparison along the isomorphism σ; and inverse of the sheaf map induced by σ viewed as an isomorphism from its terminal object over B to the terminal object of B. The inverse image is that of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. No qcqs assumption or stalk is used. The three canonical comparison isomorphisms are those of [lem-sc-etale-module-set-pullback-comparison], [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], and [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-restriction].

lean.statement: def strictLocalModuleSectionsSetEquiv (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) : let H := (sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology (forget (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))).obj F ((Sheaf.Γ (pullback f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))).obj F)) ≃ ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (pullback.snd (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s) f)).obj H).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 _)))
